senses.gloss:
नैरन्तय्य n. (-र्य्यं) Compactness, closeness, contiguity.
 E. निरन्तर,
and ष्यञ् aff.

नैराश्या n. (-श्यं) Despair.
 E. निराश, and ष्यञ् aff.

नैरुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ती-क्तं)
 1. Obsolete, uncommon, belonging to the
glossary of the Vedas 2. Acquainted with the terms of the Ve-
das.
 3. A Philologist.
 E. निरुक्ति and अण् aff.

नैरृत m. (-तः)
 1. A demon, a fiend.
 2. The ruler of the south-west
quarter.
 f. (-ती)
 1. The south-west quarter.
 2. An epithet of
Durgā.
 E. निऋति said to be a proper name, and अण् aff.

नैर्गुण्य n. (-न्यं) Absence of qualities or properties.
 E. निर्गुण, and ष्यञ् aff.

नैर्मल्य n. (-ल्यं) Cleanness, purity.
 E. निर्मल, and ष्यञ् aff.
